_comment: Laptop id (as written in the .sdk.ts files) -> the same object's id on the M7 server n8n. Credentials and data tables get new ids per instance; workflows keep theirs (import:workflow keeps ids). Ids are not secret. Read on 2026-11-11 from the server's n8n SQLite (names and ids only). Server-only objects (M7c: credential Stripe demo checkout, created 2026-11-13) map to themselves: the demo workflows exist only on the server, so their .sdk.ts files carry the server id.
